$comment: Advisories that have been READ and judged not to apply to this app.
Not a mute button: audit-gate.mjs fails on anything not listed here, and
ALSO fails once an entry is past `review_by`. An exception that never
expires is how a security gate turns into decoration.
Adding an entry means: you opened the advisory, you can say why this
codebase is not exposed, and you named a date to look again. If you
cannot write the `reason` without hedging, upgrade instead.

allow.title: braces vulnerable to stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested patterns
allow.reason: The denial of service needs an attacker to supply a deeply nested brace PATTERN to braces' expander. Here braces is reached only through tailwindcss (via micromatch, fast-glob and chokidar), which expands the static `content` globs written in tailwind.config.js ("./index.html", "./src/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}") at BUILD time and watches files in dev. No pattern comes from a user or a request: the browser bundle does not contain braces and the backend is Python. It shows up in the production tree only because tailwindcss-animate (a build-time plugin listed under dependencies) declares tailwindcss as a peer. There is no forward fix: 3.0.3 is the latest braces and the advisory lists no patched version; npm's remedy is tailwindcss 4, a major migration.
